他補充：「話雖如此，股市下跌、科技股表現落後、殖利率走低，以及美元走弱，正是我們預期AI股票熱潮若開始退燒時會出現的情況。我們認為，未來一年左右，市場可能出現更持續的回檔，而美國公債殖利率也將隨之下降。」
目前，AI投資熱潮持續退燒的證據仍然有限，但近期的市場變動確實引人注目。
高收益債券利差正在擴大，投資級債券發行人的違約保障成本也在上升，而投資人則轉向非科技產業，尋求較具防禦性的投資布局。
美國公債殖利率與債券價格呈反向變動。由於投資人對AI熱潮感到憂慮，紛紛尋求避險，公債殖利率因此下滑。AI支出放緩也可能削弱經濟成長、緩解通膨，進而支撐公債價格。企業債券面臨的風險則有所不同：市場擔心借款人償還債務的能力，正推升信用利差。
與此同時，CoreWeave股價已成為市場關注AI估值疑慮的焦點。該股自10月初高點以來已暴跌近30%，週五早盤交易時，股價接近7月底以來的最低水準。
華爾街最受尊敬的市場人士，也開始發出愈來愈強烈的警告。
傳奇投資人Paul Tudor Jones本週稍早接受CNBC訪問時表示，11月期中選舉可能為股市帶來提振，但他也補充說：「如果把目光放在一年之後，2027年將會是非常艱難的一年。」
這使得科技業第三季財報季成為市場焦點。財報季將於下週展開，由Meta Platforms和特斯拉率先公布業績；本月底前，Alphabet、亞馬遜、蘋果和微軟等科技七巨頭成員也將陸續公布財報。
然而，這些財報本身也可能緩解投資人對市場最重要產業正醞釀估值泡沫的擔憂。
22V的Dennis DeBusschere指出，相較於2000年網路泡沫高峰時期，如今各大指數的整體獲利可能更加仰賴科技股。
他表示：「然而，在估值方面，情況正好相反。大型企業的獲利實力仍相當廣泛，而AI熱潮與2000年不同之處，在於這波熱潮有實際獲利作為支撐。」
此外，科技七巨頭以外企業的獲利預測也正在改善，這顯示「相較於大型權值股，分析師如今對整體市場的看法，比過去通常更為樂觀一些」。
DeBusschere總結說：「支撐這波秋季市場漲勢的獲利基礎相當廣泛，並非只集中在少數領頭企業身上，這是它與2000年最明顯的差異。」
這是否足以讓市場在年底最後階段趨於穩定，仍有待觀察，但兩大關鍵因素可能是大型科技公司的獲利展望，以及債券市場如何評估與AI支出相關的信用風險。
Yardeni Research創辦人兼執行長Ed Yardeni也認為，這將是投資人關注的重點。他表示，「對未來投資報酬的疑慮正在推高借貸成本」，而「投資人可能因擔心AI熱潮放緩，正在下調對經濟成長的預期」。
不過，他並不預期AI投資將會放緩。他表示：「我們還遠遠不到可以宣告AI投資熱潮結束的時候。」他認為，大型雲端服務業者擁有強勁的現金流與穩健的資產負債表，「使它們的支出計畫相對不容易受到借貸成本上升的影響」，而規模較小的競爭對手則面臨困境。
他談到：「運算需求持續超過供給，而AI採用率上升應會帶動進一步投資。我們預期，大型雲端服務業者將繼續增加支出，『繁榮的2020年代』也將持續繁榮。」
未來幾週，我們將更清楚看到債券與大型科技股之間這場最新市場角力的發展。這場角力將會相當精彩。
paras_en: "An interesting thing happened in the bond market this week..." sounds like a joke among Wall Street traders, but it actually describes a notable shift in fixed‑income sentiment that could signal trouble in the final stretch of the year.

Baron Weekly reported that U.S. Treasuries surged sharply over the past three days. After September’s inflation report showed accelerating price pressures, Treasury yields rose to 5.33% mid‑day on Wednesday; however, as tech stocks and broader AI‑related trades faced worrying sell‑offs, yields fell to 5.055% on Thursday.
This shift is worth watching: despite rising global oil prices heightening inflation risk, investors seem increasingly concerned that a prolonged AI slump could hurt the economy.

BTIG technical analyst Jonathan Krinsky said, "Nowadays most people understand that bonds and oil prices are no longer correlated; they’re linked to the Nasdaq instead." He noted that Treasury yields have retreated sharply, marking the biggest weekly gain since February, while AI‑related chip stocks have also dropped.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, which tracks chip industry performance, has fallen for eight consecutive trading days, deepening its bear market and setting the longest losing streak since 2008.

AI worries have spread across market segments, affecting both the "Big Seven" tech index and the broader Nasdaq Composite. The Big Seven index fell 2.1% over the past two days; the Nasdaq Composite is down 2.4% this week and has turned negative for the month.

Capital Economics economist Jonas Goltermann said the bond market’s focus on every tech‑stock move this week is "a deviation from the recent norm." It may simply reflect an unexpected data point, while investors have been building uncertainty since the summer.

He added, "That said, falling stocks, lagging tech performance, lower yields and a weaker dollar are exactly what we expect when the AI hype starts to cool. We think the market could see a more sustained pullback over the next year, with Treasury yields falling alongside it."
Evidence that the AI investment frenzy is cooling remains limited, but recent market moves are certainly noteworthy.
High‑yield spreads are widening, investment‑grade issuers are seeing higher default‑protection costs, and investors are shifting toward non‑tech sectors for more defensive positioning.

U.S. Treasury yields move inversely to bond prices. Because investors are nervous about the AI hype, they are seeking safety, pushing yields lower. Slower AI spending could also dampen growth and ease inflation, supporting Treasury prices. Corporate bond risk is different: market concerns about borrowers’ ability to repay are widening credit spreads.

Meanwhile, CoreWeave’s stock has become a focal point for AI‑valuation doubts. The share has plunged nearly 30% since its early‑October peak and was trading near its lowest level since late July on Friday morning.
Even Wall Street’s most respected figures are sounding increasingly strong warnings.

Legendary investor Paul Tudor Jones told CNBC earlier this week that the November midterm elections could boost the market, but he added, "If you look a year ahead, 2027 is going to be a very tough year."

This makes the third‑quarter tech earnings season the market’s focal point. The season kicks off next week with Meta Platforms and Tesla reporting first, followed by Alphabet, Amazon, Apple and Microsoft before month‑end.
However, those earnings themselves could also ease investors’ concerns about a valuation bubble brewing in the market’s most important sector.
22V’s Dennis DeBusschere noted that, compared with the peak of the 2000 dot‑com bubble, overall earnings across major indices may now rely even more on tech stocks.
He said, "But on the valuation side, the situation is the opposite. Large‑cap earnings remain broadly strong, and the AI boom differs from 2000 because it is backed by real profits."

Furthermore, earnings forecasts for companies outside the Big Seven are improving, indicating that "analysts are now generally more optimistic about the overall market than they used to be, relative to large‑cap stocks."
DeBusschere summed up, "The profit base supporting this autumn market rally is broad, not concentrated in a handful of leaders, which is the clearest difference from 2000."

Whether that will be enough to steady the market in the final weeks of the year remains to be seen, but two key factors are likely: the earnings outlook of large tech firms and how the bond market prices credit risk tied to AI spending.

Yardeni Research founder and CEO Ed Yardeni also sees this as a focal point for investors. He said, "Concerns about future investment returns are pushing up borrowing costs," and "investors may be lowering growth expectations because they fear the AI hype is slowing."

However, he does not expect AI investment to cool. He said, "We are far from being able to declare the AI investment boom over." He believes large cloud providers have strong cash flows and solid balance sheets, "making their spending plans relatively insulated from higher borrowing costs," while smaller rivals face challenges.

He noted, "Compute demand continues to outstrip supply, and rising AI adoption should drive further investment. We expect large cloud providers to keep increasing spend, and the 'prosperous 2020s' will keep thriving."
In the coming weeks we will see more clearly the evolution of the latest market tug‑of‑war between bonds and large‑cap tech stocks. That battle promises to be quite a spectacle.

items.title: 華爾街老將示警：美股早已「內部崩盤」！看好Nike、白銀布局機會
items.title_en: Wall Street Veteran Warns: US Stocks Already 'Internally Collapsed'—Bullish on Nike and Silver Opportunities
paras: 投資人若擔心美股即將全面崩盤，不妨先看看市場內部的情況。華爾街資深人士Larry McDonald指出，許多股票早已大幅貶值，市場其實已經歷一場「崩盤」。
儘管標普500指數(S&P 500)近期再創歷史新高，身為《The Bear Traps Report》作者的McDonald仍表示，市場「內部已經崩盤」。他說：「看看那些名列殿堂級的品牌，哈雷(Harley-Davidson)(HOG-US)股價下跌30%至40%，Lennar(LEN-US)下跌45%，這些都是非常優秀的美國品牌」，如今卻遭到重挫。

指數創新高與個股下跌背離 被動投資制度遭質疑

McDonald將指數屢創新高、個股卻遭到拋售的背離現象，歸因於日益「失靈」的被動投資制度。
隨著退休基金及指數股票型基金(ETF)持續流入大型科技股，State Street SPDR標普500 ETF Trust(SPY-US)等指數基金表面上仍穩健，但市場內部的分化卻愈來愈嚴重。
他指出，機構投資人與避險基金，也就是所謂的「聰明錢」，一方面做多指數，另一方面則放空大量個股，押注這些股票下跌。
此外，季底與年底的稅損賣壓也加劇市場波動。這是因為，共同基金與個人投資人會賣出表現最差的股票，以降低資本利得稅負，已經承受壓力的股票因此進一步下跌，其他公司股票也可能僅因投資人採取稅損策略而遭到賣出。

CoreWeave可轉債融資警訊 重演1999與2021年情境？

曾任雷曼兄弟(Lehman Brothers)不良債務與可轉換證券副總裁的McDonald，也對可轉換公司債市場感到憂心，尤其是新型雲端服務商(neocloud)。
可轉換公司債是可由發行人轉換為普通股的債券。以CoreWeave(CRWV-US)為例，該公司本周稍早引發股市投資人不安，其高收益債券因市場擔憂借款速度，以及AI投資最終能否獲得回報而大幅下跌。
McDonald表示，CoreWeave是「反覆發行可轉換債券的公司」，過去曾多次透過這類市場籌資的公司，包括Tyco與恩隆(Enron)。
他認為，這是「真正的警訊，因為這已經是最後一家酒館」，意指企業可能已接近其他融資管道難以為繼的階段。
他說：「上兩次出現這種情況是在1999年與2021年，這兩次都極具預示性，顯示重大事件即將到來。」2000年隨後發生網路泡沫崩盤，2022年則是股市表現不佳的一年，科技股尤其受到衝擊，部分原因是美國利率上升。

預期Fed降息三次 看好白銀與黃金

針對聯準會(Fed)利率動向，McDonald採取逆勢觀點，認為降息三次的可能性遠高於再升息三次。
他指出，面向消費者的企業正承受「巨大壓力」，包括麥當勞(MCD-US)、家得寶(HD-US)、Netflix(NFLX-US)、Nike(NKE-US)與Lululemon(LULU-US)，這些公司的股價今年以來跌幅已達雙位數，而消費者也正面臨能源及其他成本上升的壓力。
McDonald預期，Fed可能再升息一次，之後官員才會「表明轉向較寬鬆政策路徑的意圖」。
基於這項判斷，他認為現在是布局黃金與白銀的適當時機，因為貨幣政策寬鬆可能帶動大宗商品進入多頭行情。
貴金屬通常會在利率下滑時上漲，利率上升時下跌，而黃金價格今年來累積下跌3%，白銀則下跌18%。
McDonald認為，白銀是未來12個月「看起來最具吸引力的交易之一」。他說：「我看好白銀，因為資料中心支出正在增加。全球太陽能產業的成長簡直瘋狂，美國與中國即將新增的太陽能裝置容量也非常可觀。這些因素都對白銀有利。」
他進一步指出，美國家庭目前的貴金屬持有比例偏低。

Nike股價較52周高點腰斬 自由現金流與股息成支撐

McDonald也看好遭重挫的消費股Nike，目前該股股價已從52周高點下跌約50%。
他表示，雖然許多投資組合經理人寧可在邁向2027年之際持有輝達(NVDA-US)，也不願買進正努力扭轉營運困境的Nike，但他看好Nike的自由現金流與股息，認為這些因素能提供一定程度的「下檔保護」。
FactSet調查的分析師預估，Nike未來12個月每股自由現金流將達1.36美元。以周四收盤價37.14美元計算，預估自由現金流殖利率為3.65%。
Nike目前年股息為每股1.64美元，股息殖利率達4.42%，高於預估自由現金流殖利率，也高於過去12個月自由現金流殖利率的3.82%。
McDonald表示，他正關注一項可能在更長期內有利於Nike的重大事件。他說：「到了2028年夏季奧運，如果Nike股價從現在起上漲100%、150%甚至200%，我也不會感到意外。」
paras_en: If investors worry about a full-blown collapse of the US market, they should first look at the internal conditions. Senior Wall Street figure Larry McDonald points out that many stocks have already depreciated significantly, and the market has in fact experienced a 'collapse'.

Despite the S&P 500 recently hitting a new historical high, McDonald, author of The Bear Traps Report, still says the market has 'internally collapsed'. He says, 'Look at those hall‑of‑fame brands: Harley‑Davidson (HOG-US) has fallen 30% to 40%, Lennar (LEN-US) has fallen 45%. These are excellent American brands, yet they have been hit hard.'
McDonald attributes the divergence between index highs and individual stock sell‑offs to the increasingly 'failing' passive investment system.

As retirement funds and ETFs continue to flow into large tech stocks, index funds such as State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY-US) appear solid on the surface, but internal market fragmentation is worsening.
He notes that institutional investors and hedge funds—what he calls 'smart money'—are long on indices while shorting large numbers of individual stocks, betting on their decline.

Seasonal tax‑loss selling at quarter‑end and year‑end also amplifies volatility. Mutual funds and individual investors sell the worst performers to reduce capital gains tax, further depressing those stocks and causing others to be sold merely because investors are employing tax‑loss strategies.
McDonald, former VP of Lehman Brothers’ distressed debt and convertible securities, is also concerned about the convertible bond market, especially new cloud service providers.

Convertible bonds can be turned into common stock by the issuer. Take CoreWeave (CRWV-US) as an example: the company earlier this week caused unease among investors as its high‑yield bonds fell sharply amid concerns about borrowing speed and whether AI investment will ultimately pay off.
McDonald says CoreWeave is a 'company that repeatedly issues convertible bonds', and that companies like Tyco and Enron have raised capital through similar markets.
He believes this is a 'real warning, because this is already the last bar', implying that companies may be approaching a stage where other financing channels become difficult to sustain.

He says the last two occurrences were in 1999 and 2021, both highly prescient, indicating a major event was imminent. The dot‑com bubble burst in 2000, and 2022 was a poor year for the market, especially tech stocks, partly due to rising US rates.
McDonald takes a contrarian view on Fed rate moves, believing the likelihood of three rate cuts far outweighs the chance of three hikes.

He points out that consumer‑facing companies are under 'huge pressure', including McDonald’s (MCD-US), Home Depot (HD-US), Netflix (NFLX-US), Nike (NKE-US) and Lululemon (LULU-US). These companies’ stocks have fallen double‑digits this year, and consumers are facing rising energy and other costs.
McDonald expects the Fed may raise rates once more, after which officials will 'signal an intention to shift toward a more accommodative policy path'.
Based on this assessment, he believes now is an appropriate time to position gold and silver, as monetary easing could drive commodities into a bullish trend.
Precious metals typically rise when rates fall and fall when rates rise; gold has fallen 3% this year, while silver has fallen 18%.

McDonald believes silver is 'one of the most attractive trades over the next 12 months'. He says, 'I am bullish on silver because data center spend is increasing. The global solar industry is growing crazily, and the US and China are set to add significant solar capacity. These factors all favor silver.'
He further notes that US households currently hold a low proportion of precious metals.
McDonald also sees upside in the heavily hit consumer stock Nike, whose price has fallen about 50% from its 52‑week high.

He says that while many portfolio managers prefer to hold Nvidia (NVDA-US) as they head toward 2027, they are reluctant to buy Nike, which is trying to turn around its operations. However, he is bullish on Nike’s free cash flow and dividends, believing these factors provide a certain level of downside protection.
FactSet analysts estimate Nike’s free cash flow per share over the next 12 months will reach $1.36. Using Thursday’s closing price of $37.14, the implied free‑cash‑flow yield is 3.65%.
Nike currently pays an annual dividend of $1.64 per share, yielding 4.42%, higher than the estimated free‑cash‑flow yield and higher than the past 12‑month free‑cash‑flow yield of 3.82%.

McDonald says he is watching a major event that could benefit Nike in the longer term. He says, 'By the 2028 Summer Olympics, if Nike’s stock rises 100%, 150% or even 200% from now, I would not be surprised.'

items.title: 輝達RTX Spark筆電開賣！大模型暴瘦85% 740億參數塞進22.1GB
items.title_en: NVIDIA RTX Spark Laptops Launch! Massive Model Slimmed by 85% to Fit 740 Billion Parameters into 22.1 GB
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)開放了Nemotron 3.5 Bolt的模型權重。原本約148GB，一口氣砍掉約85%，瞄準24GB級本地部署。
Ollama已經給出接入OpenClaw的入口。AI代理在本機讀文件、改代碼，負責推理的大模型也可以在本機運行，少了一趟趟往雲端跑。
模型放出來，電腦也開賣。10月16日，搭載RTX Spark的筆電全球發售，聯想、微軟等廠商的新機正式登場。
大模型和新電腦，黃仁勳一起端出來了。一句「幫我改下程式碼」，到了代理那兒，往往得忙活好幾輪。先讀文件、找位置，再動手改，執行報錯了，還得回頭重來。
每走一步，背後的模型都可能要再想一輪。如果推理全在雲端，這些請求就得來回跑。Bolt想接下的，就是這些可以留在電腦上的日常工作。它每次生成token激活約90億參數，但740億參數的家底都在。工具調用、圖片和影片輸入也都支援，程式碼和圖表都能交給它讀。
訓練時，團隊就讓它進入模擬環境練習工具操作，學習少繞彎、少做無用功。代理少走一次彎路，螢幕前的人就少等一輪。
最終量化版Bolt，在考驗終端操作的Terminal-Bench 2.1拿到50.98%，在考驗上網找資訊的BrowseComp拿到66.75%。這兩項都是代理執行任務時不可或缺的能力。
Ollama已經列出OpenClaw、Hermes等框架的啟動入口。開發者可以給熟悉的代理換上本地模型，聯網搜尋照常聯網，推理則交給自己的電腦。
這樣，文件、工具和負責推理的模型，就能在同一台電腦上碰頭。龍蝦在本地工作，大腦也有了本地的住處。
148GB壓成22.1GB！大模型暴瘦85%
Bolt的底子，來自這次一起發布的1200億參數Nemotron 3.5 Super VL。後者每次激活120億參數，面向企業代理，圖表、文件、影片都能讀，看完還能調用工具接著工作。
企業還可以拿自家資料繼續訓練它。到了財務平台Ramp手裡，它就被派去辨識收據，把商戶、日期和付款資訊整理成程式能讀取的資料。報銷時那些磨人的抄抄填填，正好讓它接手。
輪到Bolt，團隊要讓這位「大哥」住進筆電。先動模型結構，從1200億參數壓到740億，再把受損的能力練回來。
麻煩出在看螢幕上。前面的壓縮只動了語言部分，恢復訓練也先保文字能力；原來的視覺模組接回來，和這副縮小的底子還得重新磨合。
讓它按指令在螢幕上找目標，問題就暴露了：ScreenSpot Pro這項測試，父模型得分41.6%，剛壓縮完、還沒補視覺訓練的Bolt卻掉到了0。
於是，團隊先用每輪約660萬張圖像訓練視覺適配器，再做視覺任務微調，把成績拉回39.79%。瘦身省下的空間，差點把「眼力」也一起省掉了。
眼力補回來了，體積還沒過關。740億參數按BF16精度保存，光權重就約148GB，連最高128GB統一記憶體的RTX Spark筆電也裝不下。
接下來，每個參數也得少佔點地方。佔大頭的專家權重被壓到約2bit，其他部分保留不同精度，再用「量化感知蒸餾」向教師模型補課，盡量追回精度損失。權重終於瘦到22.1GB。
這組實驗裡，同樣的記憶體預算下，先把大模型練好再瘦身，反而比從頭練小模型、再做4bit量化留下了更高的準確率。
裝得下，還得跑得快。Bolt請來一個叫LiLiCorr的小模型先打草稿，主模型再成批驗收，減少逐個生成token的等待。
在輝達的程式碼生成測試中，搭載RTX Spark的128GB版Surface Laptop Ultra，讓Bolt跑到了約84token/s。
真正配電腦時，還要給快取、視覺模組和加速小模型留位置。按Unsloth的短上下文建議，32GB記憶體或統一記憶體可作為規劃起點，48至64GB更寬裕，22.1GB只是權重的帳單。
RTX Spark的電腦已經開賣，接下來就輪到這些模型上場。Blackwell RTX GPU和Grace CPU整合在一顆超級晶片裡，CPU與GPU共用最高128GB統一記憶體。
模型拼命瘦身，電腦這邊也得騰地方。兩邊一起往前推，本地代理才更容易跑起來。
Artificial Analysis拿了一款更大的模型來試這道門檻。Ling 3.0 Flash量化後，光權重就有77GB。
測試中的64GB MacBook Pro和32GB顯示記憶體的RTX 5090都裝不下，128GB的RTX Spark筆電還能繼續跑。
旗艦顯示卡也會遇到這種尷尬：算得再快，模型太大，照樣進不了門。到了本地AI這裡，挑電腦還得看看它的「肚量」。
輝達也把OpenClaw和Hermes列進了發售時的應用生態，並提供引導安裝。想讓更多人養上龍蝦，第一關總不能先考環境配置。
養龍蝦之餘，這台電腦也得照顧原來的工作。RTX Spark首發支援數百款遊戲，Photoshop和Premiere的原生支援也透過首發測試版提供，處理完AI任務，還能接著剪片、玩遊戲。
連740億參數都嫌大，還有更小的一檔。Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB計畫10月23日推出，面向本地語音助理、互動角色等場景。
Super VL接企業裡的複雜工作，Bolt把日常代理任務搬進筆電，E4B再去照顧更輕巧的設備。這一家子，分頭上班。
黃仁勳的算盤也很清楚：開放模型，讓更多AI任務用上使用者手邊的GPU；新電腦開賣，再把這份需求接過來。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) has released the model weights for Nemotron 3.5 Bolt. The original checkpoint was about 148 GB; it has been trimmed by roughly 85% to target 24 GB‑class local deployment.

Ollama now provides an entry point for OpenClaw integration. AI agents can read files and edit code locally, and the large model that does the inference can also run on the machine, eliminating the need to ping the cloud repeatedly.
With the model out, the laptops are on sale. On October 16, RTX Spark‑equipped notebooks went on global sale, with new machines from Lenovo, Microsoft and others officially launched.

Large models and the new computers are being showcased together by Jensen Huang. A simple request like “help me fix this code” often requires several back‑and‑forth steps with the agent: read the file, locate the spot, edit, run, handle errors, and start over.

Each step may require the model to think again. If inference runs entirely in the cloud, these requests have to travel back and forth. Bolt is designed to keep such everyday tasks on the computer. It activates about 9 billion parameters per generated token, while the full 740 billion‑parameter backbone remains intact. Tool calls, image and video inputs are supported, and it can read code and charts as well.

During training, the team let the model practice tool use in a simulated environment, learning to take fewer detours and avoid wasted effort. When the agent makes fewer missteps, the user in front of the screen waits less.

The final quantized Bolt scored 50.98% on the terminal‑operation benchmark Terminal‑Bench 2.1 and 66.75% on the web‑search benchmark BrowseComp—both essential capabilities for an agent executing tasks.

Ollama has listed launch entries for frameworks such as OpenClaw and Hermes. Developers can swap in a familiar local model for their agents, keep online search online, and run inference on their own machines.
In this way, documents, tools, and the inference model can all meet on the same computer. The “lobster” works locally, and its brain now has a local home as well.
148 GB compressed to 22.1 GB! The massive model loses 85% of its size.

Bolt’s foundation comes from the 120 billion‑parameter Nemotron 3.5 Super VL released at the same time. The latter activates 12 billion parameters per step, is aimed at enterprise agents, and can read charts, documents and videos, then invoke tools to continue working.

Enterprises can further fine‑tune it with their own data. On the financial platform Ramp, for example, it can be tasked with receipt recognition, extracting merchant, date and payment info into machine‑readable data, taking over the tedious manual entry during reimbursements.

Now it’s Bolt’s turn: the team needs to fit this “big brother” into a laptop. They first re‑architect the model, shrinking it from 120 billion to 740 million parameters, then retrain to recover the lost capabilities.

The difficulty shows up on the screen. The earlier compression only touched the language part, and the initial recovery focused on text ability; the original vision module had to be re‑integrated and re‑aligned with the smaller backbone.

When asked to locate a target on the screen, the problem became obvious: on the ScreenSpot Pro test the parent model scored 41.6%, but the freshly compressed Bolt with no vision fine‑tuning dropped to 0.

Consequently, the team trained a visual adapter on roughly 6.6 million images per round, then performed visual‑task fine‑tuning, lifting the score back to 39.79%. The space saved by slimming almost ate away the model’s “eyes” as well.

After restoring vision, the size still didn’t fit. Stored in BF16 precision, the 740 billion parameters weigh about 148 GB, which even the RTX Spark laptop with a maximum 128 GB unified memory cannot accommodate.

Next, each parameter had to take up less space. The dominant expert weights were quantized to roughly 2 bits, other parts kept at varied precisions, and “quantization‑aware distillation” was used to let a teacher model teach the student, recapturing as much accuracy as possible. The weights finally shrank to 22.1 GB.

In this experiment, with the same memory budget, training the large model first and then slimming it yielded higher accuracy than training a small model from scratch and then applying 4‑bit quantization.

Fitting is only half the battle; it must also run fast. Bolt uses a tiny model called LiLiCorr to draft quickly, while the main model processes batches, reducing the wait time for generating each token.
In NVIDIA’s code‑generation benchmark, the 128 GB RTX Spark‑equipped Surface Laptop Ultra ran Bolt at roughly 84 tokens per second.

When actually configuring a machine, space must also be reserved for cache, the vision module and the acceleration tiny model. Following Unsloth’s short‑context recommendation, 32 GB of memory or unified memory is a baseline, 48–64 GB is more comfortable, and the 22.1 GB figure refers only to the weight file.

RTX Spark laptops are now on sale, and the models are next in line. The Blackwell RTX GPU and Grace CPU are integrated on a single super‑chip, sharing up to 128 GB of unified memory between CPU and GPU.
As models aggressively slim down, the computers also need to make room. Pushing both sides forward makes local agents much easier to run.
Artificial Analysis tested a larger model against this threshold. After Flash quantization, Ling 3.0’s weights alone occupy 77 GB.
The tested 64 GB MacBook Pro and an RTX 5090 with 32 GB of video memory could not hold it, but a 128 GB RTX Spark laptop could still run it.

Even flagship graphics cards face this awkwardness: no matter how fast they compute, a model that’s too large simply won’t fit. For local AI, the computer’s “stomach capacity” matters as much as its speed.

NVIDIA also listed OpenClaw and Hermes as part of the launch‑time application ecosystem and provided guided installation. To let more people “raise lobsters,” the first hurdle can’t be a complex environment setup.

While nurturing lobsters, the laptop still needs to handle its original workloads. RTX Spark’s launch supports hundreds of games, native Photoshop and Premiere support via the launch‑preview builds, so after AI tasks it can still edit video or play games.

Even a 740 billion‑parameter model feels large; an even smaller variant is coming. Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B, a 4 GB model, is slated for release on October 23, targeting local voice assistants, interactive characters and similar scenarios.
Super VL tackles complex enterprise work, Bolt brings everyday agent tasks to laptops, and E4B will serve lighter‑weight devices. The family works in parallel, each on its own front.
Jensen Huang’s calculus is clear: open models so more AI tasks can run on users’ GPUs; launch new computers, and capture that demand with them.

items.title: 美銀、花旗出手限制AI代理 銀行為何開始害怕「智慧理財」？
paras: 花旗（Citigroup）和美國銀行（BofA）已成為最新一批限制AI代理（AI agents）存取客戶帳戶的美國銀行。近期，多家銀行向監管機構表達擔憂，認為AI代理可能為了追求更高收益而轉移閒置現金，進而導致銀行存款流失。
花旗表示，不允許「第三方AI代理登入客戶帳戶，或直接在我們的數位銀行平台內進行交易」。該行補充說，這項措施旨在保護客戶帳戶及其訊息安全。
美銀執行長Brian Moynihan也暗示，該行正在限制AI代理存取消費者存款，同時制定相關協議，以釐清由AI代理授權的支付最終應由哪一方承擔責任。
本週稍早，Moynihan接受採訪時表示：「我們強烈認為，在資金從你的帳戶轉出之前，應該有人類參與並進行授權。」
他接著說：「你肯定不希望消費者回來告訴我們：『我的帳戶裡有一筆錢被轉走了，我不知道為什麼，也不知道錢去了哪裡，而這一切都是AI代理做的。』」
上月，Meta推出個人AI代理Muse。該產品迅速受到關注，也引發外界擔憂：AI代理可能代表消費者，將大量閒置現金從銀行存款帳戶轉移出去，以尋求更高收益。
Apollo經濟學家Torsten Slok警告，AI代理可能會自動將家庭閒置現金轉入年利率3.3%至5%的帳戶，而美國支票帳戶的全國平均利率僅有0.1%。
摩根大通、美國銀行和富國銀行目前合計持有約1.6兆美元的無息存款，相當於三家銀行負債的16%。如果這些存款需要支付3%的利息，銀行每年將增加約470億美元的利息成本。
如果銀行為了防止零售客戶將資金轉往其他地方賺取更高利率，而被迫提高存款利率，可能對銀行獲利造成重大打擊。
Slok寫道：「如果每個家庭都使用AI代理來最佳化現金餘額的收益率，那麼銀行可能會失去相當大一部分用於支應貸款業務的低成本存款，而這將成為整個金融體系的問題。」
監管機構私下對銀行阻止AI代理存取客戶帳戶的做法表示歡迎。監管官員認為，未來可能需要透過法律進一步釐清兩個問題：

客戶應如何授權自主運作的AI代理代表自己執行金融交易。
如果交易發生問題，究竟應由誰承擔法律責任。


花旗表示，在某些開放銀行服務商的平台上，客戶仍可授權對其帳戶訊息進行有限的唯讀存取。
摩根大通執行長戴蒙（Jamie Dimon）本週也表示，該行將嚴格限制AI代理存取客戶銀行帳戶。
戴蒙表示，「因為你不希望出現失控的AI代理，而且這樣的代理可能會有成千上萬個，我們必須確保以正確的方式保護客戶。因此，我們也正在開發相應的工具。」
他補充，「在此之前，我們不會允許任何外部AI代理隨意進入公司系統，因為這對客戶和摩根大通而言，風險都太高了。」
諮詢公司Simon-Kucher合夥人Christoph Stegmeier表示，銀行將越來越需要尋找方法，透過各種獎勵措施，讓客戶繼續將儲蓄留在銀行。
例如，銀行可以擴大客戶忠誠度計畫，並讓這些計畫影響客戶能獲得的貸款利率等金融產品條件。「你必須讓你的存款產品變得更有黏性。」

items.title: AI陷入「疲勞交易」！投資人厭倦反覆爭論科技承諾 分析師：市場需要營收證明
items.title_en: AI Falls into 'Fatigue Trading'! Investors Tired of Repeated Debates Over Tech Promises, Analysts Say Market Needs Revenue Proof
paras: 費城半導體指數周五(16日)連續第八個交易日收黑，創18年來最長連跌紀錄，分析師認為，人工智慧(AI)最終可能帶來回報，但投資人已逐漸厭倦反覆討論科技投資的短期回報，以及市場對此抱持的疑慮。
DataTrek Research共同創辦人Nicholas Colas將當前市場走勢稱為「AI疲勞交易」(AI burnout trade)。換言之，投資人對於不斷預測科技投資何時能帶來回報感到厭倦，尤其這些投資的回報時間遙遠且充滿不確定性。他們也厭倦了反覆爭論這些投資對當前市場究竟意味著什麼。
Colas寫道：「標普500指數的投資人，應該關注未來36個月，還是未來10年？我們都知道答案是後者，但一直為前者憂心，可能會讓人筋疲力盡，坦白說情況確實如此。」
Rational Equity Armor Fund共同投資組合經理人Luke Rahbari也表示，投資人正愈來愈難以從AI相關雜音中釐清方向。這些訊息包括AI將帶來革命性成長的遠大承諾、資料中心建置的龐大成本、AI可能取代工作的疑慮，以及幾乎每天都有新的晶片或模型問世。
他認同，許多投資人已厭倦試圖提前數年預測這些投資最終能帶來多少回報。

市場不再只看AI投資規模 要求營收成長證據

過去幾年，企業只要宣布推出更大型的模型、興建更大的資料中心，或加碼AI基礎設施投資，股價往往就能獲得市場獎勵。但StoneX分析師Yi Fu Lee認為，這種情況正在改變，投資人如今要求更明確的證據，證明資本支出能轉化為可持續的營收成長。
金融市場近來對OpenAI與Anthropic等主要私人AI公司的財務指標報告感到不安。Lee表示，當市場預期與實際公布的數據出現落差時，市場可能「毫不留情」，AI相關股票也很快就顯露疲態。
BCA Research首席經濟學家Peter Berezin說，另一項疑慮是，AI代幣(token)的使用支出可能正在放緩。代幣是AI模型處理的資料單位，也是服務供應商計費的依據，若這項支出減速，可能為AI企業帶來挑戰。
根據Berezin的估算，AI企業每年需要創造10兆美元營收，才能讓AI資料中心投資取得「合理的投資報酬率」。

半導體指數連跌8天　CoreWeave成融資疑慮焦點

費城半導體指數(SOX)已連續第8個交易日下跌，並跌至一個月來最低水準。被視為AI借款需求代表企業的CoreWeave(CRWV-US)，股價也跌至7月以來最低點，該公司出租輝達(NVDA-US)的圖形處理器(GPU)，並為OpenAI等AI研究機構提供服務
Lee表示，投資人正逐漸厭倦「憑信念為AI融資」。一旦市場開始質疑企業能否為基礎設施融資，並相信多年後才能實現投資回報，投資人就可能迅速予以懲罰。
Colas也指出，其他因素同樣令投資人不安，例如一般民眾可能根本沒有付費使用AI，或是許多美國人對科技逐漸滲透日常生活，至多只抱持褒貶不一的態度。
Colas寫道：「市場永遠厭惡不確定性，而AI領域的不確定性已經足以引發大量投資人不滿。」不過，他也表示：「在我們看來，這還不足以構成一個令人信服的股市看空理由。」他認為，AI長期而言仍將帶來回報。
paras_en: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index closed down for the eighth consecutive trading day on Friday (the 16th), setting an 18‑year record for the longest streak of declines. Analysts say AI may eventually deliver returns, but investors are growing weary of repeatedly debating the short‑term payoff of tech investments and the market’s lingering doubts.

DataTrek Research co‑founder Nicholas Colas describes the current market trend as an “AI burnout trade.” In other words, investors are tired of constantly forecasting when tech investments will pay off, especially since the payoff horizon is distant and fraught with uncertainty. They are also fed up with endless arguments about what these investments actually mean for the market today.

Colas wrote: “Should S&P 500 investors focus on the next 36 months or the next ten years? We all know the answer is the latter, but worrying about the former can be exhausting – frankly, that’s exactly what’s happening.”

Rational Equity Armor Fund co‑portfolio manager Luke Rahbari also notes that investors are finding it increasingly difficult to cut through the AI‑related noise. The chatter includes grand promises of revolutionary growth, massive data‑center construction costs, fears that AI could replace jobs, and the near‑daily launch of new chips or models.
He agrees that many investors are tired of trying to predict years in advance how much return these investments will ultimately generate.

The market no longer looks solely at AI investment size; it demands evidence of revenue growth. In past years, companies that announced larger models, bigger data centers, or increased AI infrastructure spending often saw their stock prices rewarded. StoneX analyst Yi Fu Lee believes that is changing – investors now want clear proof that capital outlays can translate into sustainable revenue growth.

Financial markets have recently grown uneasy about the financial metrics reported by major private AI firms such as OpenAI and Anthropic. Lee says that when market expectations diverge from disclosed data, the market can be “relentless,” and AI‑related stocks quickly show signs of fatigue.

BCA Research chief economist Peter Berezin says another concern is that spending on AI tokens may be slowing. Tokens are the data units processed by AI models and the basis for service‑provider billing; a slowdown could pose challenges for AI companies.
Berezin estimates AI firms need to generate $10 trillion in annual revenue for AI data‑center investments to achieve a “reasonable return on investment.”

The semiconductor index has fallen for eight straight days, and CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), seen as a bellwether for AI borrowing demand, has also dropped to its lowest level since July. The company rents NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) GPUs and provides services to AI research outfits such as OpenAI.

Lee says investors are increasingly weary of “financing AI on belief.” Once the market starts questioning whether companies can fund infrastructure and believes returns are years away, investors may swiftly punish them.

Colas also points out other worries, such as the possibility that the general public may not actually be paying to use AI, or that many Americans view the growing tech infiltration of daily life with mixed or ambivalent feelings.

Colas writes: “The market always despises uncertainty, and the uncertainty in AI is already enough to generate significant investor dissatisfaction.” However, he adds: “In our view, that alone does not constitute a compelling bearish case for the stock market.” He believes AI will still deliver returns over the long term.

items.title: AI交易平倉潮重創全球避險基金 亞洲基金首當其衝
items.title_en: AI Trading Liquidation Wave Cripples Global Hedge Funds, Asian Funds Hit Hardest
paras: 在多項人工智慧(AI)交易遭大舉平倉衝擊下，全球避險基金本周遭遇沉重損失，以聚焦亞洲市場的基金受創最深。
隨著通膨居高不下、借貸成本維持高檔，投資人愈來愈質疑，鉅額AI投資究竟何時才能帶來回報。美股周五(16日)收盤大幅下跌，CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、博通(AVGO-US)等AI概念股再度遭拋售，油價跳漲也讓交易員在周末前感到不安。
CoreWeave是這波最新賣壓中受創最深的企業之一，這家資料中心營運商的債券本周遭到大舉拋售，殖利率攀升至15%以上。

全球股票多空基金連跌5天 亞洲基金單日重挫2.6%

高盛(Goldman Sachs)主經紀業務部門在致客戶報告中指出，全球基本面股票多空基金——也就是由基金經理人挑選個股的基金——本周每天都賠錢。這類基金在10月15日為止一周內共下跌2.9%，但今年以來仍上漲14.3%。
高盛周五在報告中說：「AI交易周三遭到大幅平倉後，全球股票周四再度遭到賣超，不過速度明顯放緩。這波賣壓仍源自風險部位持續縮減，其中多單賣出規模高於空單回補。」
高盛指出，以美元計算，全球降低總曝險的交易活動——也就是賣出多單與回補空單的總和，在周四的規模約為周三的一半。
高盛並補充，全球AI類股已連續六個交易日遭股票多空基金經理人賣出。
各類策略的避險基金周四都大幅下滑：全球股票多空基金下跌0.9%，其中聚焦亞洲市場的基金下跌2.6%，科技類基金下跌2.0%。全球系統化股票多空基金及多策略基金也分別下跌約1%。
投資避險基金的Erlen Capital Management管理合夥人Bruno Schneller說：「這次發生的情況，與其說是市場從基本面否定AI，不如說是熱門交易部位過度擁擠後，在宏觀經濟現實檢驗下出現典型且快速的平倉潮。美國通膨數據高於預期，迫使市場重新評估利率走勢，立即對AI產業中資本需求最高的領域造成壓力。」

美國通膨推高升息預期 韓股重挫8%

由於美國本周公布的通膨數據提高市場對進一步升息的預期，進而拖累半導體及AI供應鏈類股下跌。半導體類股占比較高的市場承受最大賣壓，南韓KOSPI指數周四重挫8%，收在六個月低點，台股也下跌逾3%。
高盛周四稍早在另一份報告中指出，從新冠疫情期間至2025年底，基本面股票多空、系統化交易及多策略交易這三大類策略，從未在同一天同步下跌超過80個基點(0.8個百分點)。
然而，這種情況今年已發生三次，分別發生在2月4日、7月28日及10月15日。
高盛數據顯示，10月上半月，聚焦亞洲市場的選股基金下跌6.8%，自6月底高峰以來已有超過一半漲幅蒸發。當時這類基金今年來的漲幅一度超過40%。
Schneller說：「這波賣壓有意思的地方，在於它揭露避險基金產業有多大程度上實際押注於同一個核心主題，即使各基金的投資組合表面上看起來截然不同。」
paras_en: Amid a wave of massive liquidations of AI-driven trades, global hedge funds suffered heavy losses this week, with those focused on Asian markets taking the biggest hit.

With inflation staying high and borrowing costs remaining elevated, investors are increasingly questioning when massive AI investments will finally deliver returns. U.S. stocks closed sharply lower on Friday the 16th, and AI‑related names such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) and Broadcom (AVGO‑US) were sold off again, while a jump in oil prices left traders uneasy heading into the weekend.
CoreWeave was one of the hardest‑hit companies in the latest sell‑off; the data‑center operator’s bonds were dumped heavily this week, pushing yields above 15%.

Global long‑short equity funds fell for five consecutive days, with Asian‑focused funds plunging 2.6% in a single day. Goldman Sachs’ prime brokerage unit noted in a client report that global fundamental long‑short equity funds – funds that pick individual stocks – lost money every day this week. Over the week ending Oct. 15 they fell 2.9%, though they are still up 14.3% year‑to‑date.

Goldman said in its Friday report: “After AI trades were massively liquidated on Wednesday, global equities saw another wave of selling on Thursday, though the pace slowed noticeably. The pressure still stems from a continued reduction of risk‑on positions, with long‑side selling outpacing short‑side covering.”
Goldman noted that, in dollar terms, the total risk‑reduction activity worldwide – the sum of long sales and short covering – was about half on Thursday of what it had been on Wednesday.
Goldman added that AI‑related stocks have been sold by long‑short equity managers for six straight trading days.

All hedge‑fund strategies fell sharply on Thursday: global long‑short equity funds dropped 0.9%, with Asian‑focused funds down 2.6% and technology funds down 2.0%. Global systematic long‑short equity funds and multi‑strategy funds each fell roughly 1%.

Erlen Capital Management partner Bruno Schneller said, “What we’re seeing isn’t so much the market denying AI on fundamentals as it is a classic, rapid unwind after a crowded hot‑trade position runs into macro‑economic reality. Higher‑than‑expected U.S. inflation forced a reassessment of rate trajectories, immediately pressuring the AI sub‑sectors with the highest capital needs.”

U.S. inflation lifts rate‑hike expectations, South Korean stocks tumble 8%. Because U.S. inflation data released this week raised expectations of further rate hikes, semiconductor and AI‑supply‑chain stocks were dragged down. Semiconductor‑heavy markets bore the brunt, with South Korea’s KOSPI plunging 8% on Thursday to a six‑month low, while Taiwan’s market fell more than 3%.

Goldman earlier on Thursday noted in another report that from the COVID‑19 pandemic through the end of 2025, the three major strategy groups – fundamental long‑short, systematic trading and multi‑strategy – have never on the same day all dropped more than 80 basis points (0.8 percentage points).
However, that scenario has occurred three times this year, on Feb. 4, July 28 and Oct. 15.

Goldman data show that in the first half of October, Asian‑focused stock‑picking funds fell 6.8%, erasing more than half of the gains they had built since the late‑June peak. At that point those funds had been up over 40% year‑to‑date.

Schneller said, “What’s interesting about this sell‑off is that it reveals how much the hedge‑fund industry is effectively betting on the same core theme, even though the portfolios appear very different on the surface.”

items.title: 外資持有美債規模8月回升 加拿大、比利時增最多 中國砍到18年低點
items.title_en: Foreign Holdings of US Treasuries Rise in August, Canada and Belgium Add the Most, China Falls to 2018 Low
paras: 美國財政部周五(16日)公布，外國持有美債規模從2025年10月以來最低水準回升，與7月相比增加逾830億美元，總額升至9.33兆美元，主要由加拿大與比利時增加持有部位帶動。不過，中國持有量降至18年低點。

日本減持360億美元 中國持有量降至18年低點

身為持有美債規模最大的國家，日本8月的持有部位減少360億美元，降至1.1兆美元，創2024年12月以來最低水準。
日本政府今年夏季曾干預外匯市場，在日元兌美元貶至40年來最低水準時買進日元，以提供支撐。日本上月公布的數據顯示，東京當局可能出售一部分的美國公債及其他證券，來籌措干預匯市所需資金。
財政部的報告顯示，持有美債規模排名第三的中國，8月持有量減少270億美元，總額降至5,910億美元，創18年來最低水準。部分分析師指出，北京可能透過加拿大等其他國家進行一部分美國證券交易。

加拿大、比利時增持 英國持有美債首度突破1兆美元

加拿大8月持有美債規模增加380億美元，升抵近4,650億美元。比利時則增加近200億美元，達約4,910億美元。
持有美債規模排名第二的英國，8月持有量增加110億美元，總額首度突破1兆美元。
paras_en: The U.S. Treasury announced on Friday (the 16th) that foreign holdings of U.S. Treasuries have rebounded from their lowest level since October 2025, increasing by more than $83 billion from July and bringing the total to $9.33 trillion, driven mainly by larger positions taken by Canada and Belgium. However, China's holdings fell to an 18‑year low.
Japan, the largest foreign holder of U.S. Treasuries, reduced its position by $36 billion in August, bringing its total down to $1.1 trillion, the lowest since December 2024.

The Japanese government intervened in the foreign‑exchange market this summer, buying yen when the yen‑dollar rate slipped to a 40‑year low to provide support. Data released last month indicate that Tokyo authorities may sell a portion of U.S. Treasury bonds and other securities to raise the funds needed for the currency intervention.

According to the Treasury report, China, which ranks third in Treasury holdings, saw its August holdings drop by $27 billion to $591 billion, the lowest level in 18 years. Some analysts suggest Beijing may be conducting part of its U.S. securities trading through other countries such as Canada.
Canada increased its Treasury holdings by $38 billion in August, bringing its total to nearly $465 billion. Belgium added almost $20 billion, reaching about $491 billion.
The United Kingdom, the second‑largest foreign holder, raised its August holdings by $11 billion, pushing its total past the $1 trillion mark for the first time.

items.title: Roadster讓SpaceX更有價值？特斯拉能分到多少好處？
items.title_en: Does the Roadster Make SpaceX More Valuable? How Much Benefit Can Tesla Capture?
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，特斯拉(Tesla)(TSLA-US)重新設計的Roadster跑車，或許是公司財務貢獻最小、卻最能揭示戰略布局的產品之一。這款車搭載由太空公司SpaceX(SPCX-US)開發的推進器，展現跨越企業界線的工程技術，也引發投資人一個疑問。
如果這項合作強化了SpaceX的技術形象，所創造的經濟價值究竟有多少真正屬於特斯拉？在10月15日的展示中，Roadster運用結合SpaceX技術開發的冷氣體推進器進行空中動作。特斯拉將量產時間訂於2028年，意味著這款車距離對營收產生實質貢獻，仍有數年時間。
這場展示之所以重要，是因為它具體呈現了馬斯克旗下企業如何共享工程技術。特斯拉提供電動車平台，SpaceX則帶來推進技術方面的專業能力。兩者結合可能創造技術優勢，但單憑這場展示，仍無法確定任一家公司究竟能從中獲得多少收益。
據《路透社》報導，馬斯克曾將Roadster形容為「小事一樁」。這項區別很重要：一項產品即使無法成為重要的營收來源，仍可能提升企業的技術聲譽。
價值究竟歸誰所有？
Roadster帶來兩種投資論述。對特斯拉而言，這場展示強化了公司在高階工程技術方面的形象，以及打造能吸引傳統電動車市場以外關注的產品之能力。然而，Roadster屬於利基型車款，預定的量產時間也意味著它距離成為獲利成長的催化劑仍有一段時間。
對SpaceX而言，這項合作展現了其在火箭發射業務之外的推進技術專長，可能進一步強化外界對其工程能力的評價，但這並不會自動轉化為更高的營收、現金流或更具說服力的估值。
目前仍缺少的關鍵資訊，是兩家公司之間的商業安排。現有展示與相關報導並未揭露這項技術的授權費用、智慧財產權歸屬或其他財務條款。在缺乏這些細節的情況下，投資人無法可靠判斷，特斯拉是否能取得經濟利益、SpaceX是否會獲得報酬，或兩家公司是否主要透過共同開發而受益。
當投資人將這項合作解讀為兩家公司可能合併的證據時，這種不確定性就更加重要。共享工程技術平台並不等於合併，而市場對兩家公司合併的猜測，也不能證明交易已經列入計畫。
特斯拉獲利表現仍更重要
特斯拉將於10月21日公布第三季財報，這將為投資人提供比預計2028年才量產的Roadster更即時的業務檢驗。Roadster的亮相重新吸引投資人關注，但股價能否持續上漲，仍取決於特斯拉能否將技術雄心轉化為財務表現。
投資人應關注特斯拉的汽車業務利潤率、交車趨勢及未來營運指引，以判斷公司近期的進展。在兩家公司進一步揭露商業安排之前，Roadster只能證明雙方存在工程技術合作，尚不足以證明特斯拉股東能夠取得由此創造的價值。
paras_en: Benzinga reports that Tesla’s (TSLA‑US) newly redesigned Roadster sports car may be one of the company’s products with the smallest financial contribution yet the most revealing of its strategic layout. The car is equipped with a propulsion system developed by SpaceX (SPCX‑US), showcasing cross‑company engineering and prompting investors to ask a key question.

If this collaboration bolsters SpaceX’s technological image, how much of the economic value created actually belongs to Tesla? In the October 15 showcase, the Roadster performed aerial maneuvers using a cold‑gas thruster developed with SpaceX technology. Tesla has slated mass production for 2028, meaning the vehicle is still several years away from making a material revenue impact.

The showcase matters because it concretely demonstrates how Elon Musk’s companies share engineering know‑how. Tesla provides the electric‑vehicle platform, while SpaceX contributes propulsion expertise. The combination could yield a technical advantage, but the display alone does not reveal how much either firm will ultimately earn.

Reuters reported that Musk once described the Roadster as “a small thing.” That distinction matters: even a product that never becomes a major revenue source can still enhance a company’s technological reputation.
Who ultimately captures the value?

The Roadster supports two investment narratives. For Tesla, the showcase reinforces the company’s image as a high‑end engineering player and its ability to create products that attract attention beyond the traditional EV market. However, the Roadster is a niche model, and its slated production timeline means it remains a distant catalyst for profit growth.

For SpaceX, the partnership showcases its propulsion expertise beyond rocket launches, potentially strengthening external perceptions of its engineering capabilities. Yet this does not automatically translate into higher revenue, cash flow, or a more compelling valuation.

The key missing piece is the commercial arrangement between the two firms. Existing footage and reports do not disclose licensing fees, intellectual‑property ownership, or other financial terms. Without those details, investors cannot reliably assess whether Tesla will earn economic benefits, whether SpaceX will be compensated, or whether both parties primarily profit from joint development.

When investors read the partnership as evidence that the two companies might merge, the uncertainty becomes even more significant. Sharing an engineering platform does not equal a merger, and market speculation about a merger does not prove that such a transaction is being planned.
Tesla’s profit performance remains more important.

Tesla will release its third‑quarter earnings on October 21, giving investors a more immediate gauge of the business than the Roadster, which is not expected to be produced until 2028. The Roadster’s debut has rekindled investor interest, but whether the stock can keep rising depends on Tesla’s ability to turn its technical ambition into financial results.

Investors should focus on Tesla’s automotive profit margins, delivery trends, and future operating guidance to assess near‑term progress. Until the two companies disclose more about their commercial arrangement, the Roadster merely proves an engineering collaboration and is insufficient to demonstrate that Tesla shareholders will capture the value it creates.

items.title: 日相高市早苗：若國會允許 將親赴中國出席11月APEC峰會
items.title_en: Prime Minister Kishida: If Parliament Allows, She Will Attend November APEC Summit in China
paras: 日本首相高市早苗表示，若國會允許，她計劃出席由中國主辦的亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)領袖峰會，藉此在中日兩國關係陷入冰點之際，確認有意訪問中國。
高市周五(16日)在國會會議中，針對日本外交政策及政府危機處理相關問題作出回應時，表達出席APEC峰會的意願。這場峰會預定於11月18日至19日在深圳舉行。
中日緊張情勢已持續一年，APEC峰會通常為日本與中國領導人提供會面的機會，雙方不必另外安排正式訪問行程，但中國國家主席習近平今年是否會撥出時間與高市會談，仍存在不確定性。

農相醜聞引發政治壓力 高市接受辭呈

高市政府本周忙著控制農林水產大臣簗和生辭職所引發的政治衝擊，這是高市政府首名因醜聞而下台的閣員。
媒體報導指控，簗和生規避部分選舉規定，並曾吹噓自己在2月削減不支持其競選活動的地方政府資金。簗和生否認違法，並表示為避免阻礙國會運作及履行大臣職務，因此決定辭職。
高市一開始曾為簗和生辯護，但仍在提交暫停徵收消費稅的法案前接受他的辭呈。這項法案可能成為本次國會會期的主要議程。
高市處理這起醜聞的方式受到在野黨議員批評，但事件是否會對她的支持率造成持久影響，仍有待觀察。

高市談女性首相日常：每天比男性首相多工作3至4小時

高市本周也因談及女性首相與男性首相的差異而引發討論。
她周三表示：「我認為，我每天的時間比男性首相多出大約3至4個小時。」
她接著說：「如果化了妝，就必須用卸妝產品卸掉。早上我還要洗澡、準備早餐、收拾早餐後的餐具，接著才能化妝。」
paras_en: Japanese Prime Minister Kishida said that if Parliament permits, she plans to attend the APEC Leaders Summit hosted by China, using the opportunity to signal her intention to visit China as bilateral relations hit a low point.

On Friday (the 16th), Kishida expressed her willingness to attend the APEC summit while responding to questions about Japan's foreign policy and the government's crisis management during a parliamentary session. The summit is scheduled for November 18‑19 in Shenzhen.

Tensions between Japan and China have persisted for a year, and APEC summits usually give the two leaders a chance to meet without arranging a separate state visit, though it remains uncertain whether Chinese President Xi Jinping will make time to meet Kishida this year.

A scandal in the Agriculture Ministry has created political pressure, and Kishida accepted the resignation of Minister of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries Yanagihara, the first cabinet member to step down over a scandal in her administration.

Media reports allege that Yanagihara evaded certain election rules and boasted about cutting local government funding that did not support his campaign in February. Yanagihara denies any wrongdoing and says he resigned to avoid hindering parliamentary work and to fulfill his ministerial duties.

Kishida initially defended Yanagihara but accepted his resignation before submitting a bill to suspend the consumption tax increase, a measure that could become the main agenda of the current parliamentary session.
The opposition has criticized Kishida's handling of the scandal, but it remains to be seen whether the episode will have a lasting impact on her approval ratings.
Kishida also sparked discussion this week by commenting on the daily differences between a female and a male prime minister.
She said on Wednesday, "I think I work about three to four hours more each day than a male prime minister."
She added, "If I wear makeup, I have to remove it with remover. In the morning I still need to shower, prepare breakfast, clean up the dishes, and then I can put on makeup."

items.title: AI賣壓燒向債市！美債殖利率急跌 華爾街緊盯科技巨頭財報
items.title_en: AI Selling Pressure Burns Into Bond Market! U.S. Treasury Yields Plummet, Wall Street Eyes Tech Giants' Earnings
paras: 「債券市場這週發生了一件有趣的事……」這聽起來像是華爾街交易員之間流傳的笑話開場白，但它描述的是固定收益市場情緒的一項顯著轉變，而這可能預示著年底最後階段將面臨麻煩。
《巴隆周刊》報導，過去三天，美國公債大幅上漲。9月通膨報告顯示物價壓力加速升溫後，公債殖利率於週三盤中一度升至5.33%；然而，隨著科技股及更廣泛的AI投資交易遭遇令人憂心的賣壓，殖利率於週四一度降至5.055%。
這項轉變值得關注：儘管全球原油價格上漲加劇通膨風險，投資人似乎愈來愈擔心，AI市場若持續低迷，可能對經濟造成衝擊。
BTIG技術分析師Jonathan Krinsky表示：「如今，大多數人都已明白，債券與原油價格不再具有相關性，反而是與那斯達克指數相關。」他指出，美國公債殖利率大幅回落，本週漲勢為2月以來最大，同時，與AI相關的晶片股也同步下跌。
追蹤晶片產業表現的費城半導體指數已連續八個交易日下跌，不僅進一步陷入熊市，也創下2008年以來最長的連續下跌紀錄。
對AI的疑慮也蔓延至各個市場領域，從追蹤「科技七巨頭」的指數，到更廣泛的那斯達克綜合指數，都受到影響。科技七巨頭指數過去兩天下跌2.1%；那斯達克綜合指數本週下跌2.4%，本月也已轉為下跌。
Capital Economics經濟學家Jonas Goltermann表示，本週債券市場對科技股的一切動態如此關注，是「偏離近期常態」的現象。這可能只是受到一項出乎意料的經濟數據影響，而當時投資人自夏季以來便一直處於逐漸累積的不確定性之中。
他補充：「話雖如此，股市下跌、科技股表現落後、殖利率走低，以及美元走弱，正是我們預期AI股票熱潮若開始退燒時會出現的情況。我們認為，未來一年左右，市場可能出現更持續的回檔，而美國公債殖利率也將隨之下降。」
目前，AI投資熱潮持續退燒的證據仍然有限，但近期的市場變動確實引人注目。
高收益債券利差正在擴大，投資級債券發行人的違約保障成本也在上升，而投資人則轉向非科技產業，尋求較具防禦性的投資布局。
美國公債殖利率與債券價格呈反向變動。由於投資人對AI熱潮感到憂慮，紛紛尋求避險，公債殖利率因此下滑。AI支出放緩也可能削弱經濟成長、緩解通膨，進而支撐公債價格。企業債券面臨的風險則有所不同：市場擔心借款人償還債務的能力，正推升信用利差。
與此同時，CoreWeave股價已成為市場關注AI估值疑慮的焦點。該股自10月初高點以來已暴跌近30%，週五早盤交易時，股價接近7月底以來的最低水準。
華爾街最受尊敬的市場人士，也開始發出愈來愈強烈的警告。
傳奇投資人Paul Tudor Jones本週稍早接受CNBC訪問時表示，11月期中選舉可能為股市帶來提振，但他也補充說：「如果把目光放在一年之後，2027年將會是非常艱難的一年。」
這使得科技業第三季財報季成為市場焦點。財報季將於下週展開，由Meta Platforms和特斯拉率先公布業績；本月底前，Alphabet、亞馬遜、蘋果和微軟等科技七巨頭成員也將陸續公布財報。
然而，這些財報本身也可能緩解投資人對市場最重要產業正醞釀估值泡沫的擔憂。
22V的Dennis DeBusschere指出，相較於2000年網路泡沫高峰時期，如今各大指數的整體獲利可能更加仰賴科技股。
他表示：「然而，在估值方面，情況正好相反。大型企業的獲利實力仍相當廣泛，而AI熱潮與2000年不同之處，在於這波熱潮有實際獲利作為支撐。」
此外，科技七巨頭以外企業的獲利預測也正在改善，這顯示「相較於大型權值股，分析師如今對整體市場的看法，比過去通常更為樂觀一些」。
DeBusschere總結說：「支撐這波秋季市場漲勢的獲利基礎相當廣泛，並非只集中在少數領頭企業身上，這是它與2000年最明顯的差異。」
這是否足以讓市場在年底最後階段趨於穩定，仍有待觀察，但兩大關鍵因素可能是大型科技公司的獲利展望，以及債券市場如何評估與AI支出相關的信用風險。
Yardeni Research創辦人兼執行長Ed Yardeni也認為，這將是投資人關注的重點。他表示，「對未來投資報酬的疑慮正在推高借貸成本」，而「投資人可能因擔心AI熱潮放緩，正在下調對經濟成長的預期」。
不過，他並不預期AI投資將會放緩。他表示：「我們還遠遠不到可以宣告AI投資熱潮結束的時候。」他認為，大型雲端服務業者擁有強勁的現金流與穩健的資產負債表，「使它們的支出計畫相對不容易受到借貸成本上升的影響」，而規模較小的競爭對手則面臨困境。
他談到：「運算需求持續超過供給，而AI採用率上升應會帶動進一步投資。我們預期，大型雲端服務業者將繼續增加支出，『繁榮的2020年代』也將持續繁榮。」
未來幾週，我們將更清楚看到債券與大型科技股之間這場最新市場角力的發展。這場角力將會相當精彩。
paras_en: "An interesting thing happened in the bond market this week..." sounds like a joke among Wall Street traders, but it actually describes a notable shift in fixed‑income sentiment that could signal trouble in the final stretch of the year.

Baron Weekly reported that U.S. Treasuries surged sharply over the past three days. After September’s inflation report showed accelerating price pressures, Treasury yields rose to 5.33% mid‑day on Wednesday; however, as tech stocks and broader AI‑related trades faced worrying sell‑offs, yields fell to 5.055% on Thursday.
This shift is worth watching: despite rising global oil prices heightening inflation risk, investors seem increasingly concerned that a prolonged AI slump could hurt the economy.

BTIG technical analyst Jonathan Krinsky said, "Nowadays most people understand that bonds and oil prices are no longer correlated; they’re linked to the Nasdaq instead." He noted that Treasury yields have retreated sharply, marking the biggest weekly gain since February, while AI‑related chip stocks have also dropped.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, which tracks chip industry performance, has fallen for eight consecutive trading days, deepening its bear market and setting the longest losing streak since 2008.

AI worries have spread across market segments, affecting both the "Big Seven" tech index and the broader Nasdaq Composite. The Big Seven index fell 2.1% over the past two days; the Nasdaq Composite is down 2.4% this week and has turned negative for the month.

Capital Economics economist Jonas Goltermann said the bond market’s focus on every tech‑stock move this week is "a deviation from the recent norm." It may simply reflect an unexpected data point, while investors have been building uncertainty since the summer.

He added, "That said, falling stocks, lagging tech performance, lower yields and a weaker dollar are exactly what we expect when the AI hype starts to cool. We think the market could see a more sustained pullback over the next year, with Treasury yields falling alongside it."
Evidence that the AI investment frenzy is cooling remains limited, but recent market moves are certainly noteworthy.
High‑yield spreads are widening, investment‑grade issuers are seeing higher default‑protection costs, and investors are shifting toward non‑tech sectors for more defensive positioning.

U.S. Treasury yields move inversely to bond prices. Because investors are nervous about the AI hype, they are seeking safety, pushing yields lower. Slower AI spending could also dampen growth and ease inflation, supporting Treasury prices. Corporate bond risk is different: market concerns about borrowers’ ability to repay are widening credit spreads.

Meanwhile, CoreWeave’s stock has become a focal point for AI‑valuation doubts. The share has plunged nearly 30% since its early‑October peak and was trading near its lowest level since late July on Friday morning.
Even Wall Street’s most respected figures are sounding increasingly strong warnings.

Legendary investor Paul Tudor Jones told CNBC earlier this week that the November midterm elections could boost the market, but he added, "If you look a year ahead, 2027 is going to be a very tough year."

This makes the third‑quarter tech earnings season the market’s focal point. The season kicks off next week with Meta Platforms and Tesla reporting first, followed by Alphabet, Amazon, Apple and Microsoft before month‑end.
However, those earnings themselves could also ease investors’ concerns about a valuation bubble brewing in the market’s most important sector.
22V’s Dennis DeBusschere noted that, compared with the peak of the 2000 dot‑com bubble, overall earnings across major indices may now rely even more on tech stocks.
He said, "But on the valuation side, the situation is the opposite. Large‑cap earnings remain broadly strong, and the AI boom differs from 2000 because it is backed by real profits."

Furthermore, earnings forecasts for companies outside the Big Seven are improving, indicating that "analysts are now generally more optimistic about the overall market than they used to be, relative to large‑cap stocks."
DeBusschere summed up, "The profit base supporting this autumn market rally is broad, not concentrated in a handful of leaders, which is the clearest difference from 2000."

Whether that will be enough to steady the market in the final weeks of the year remains to be seen, but two key factors are likely: the earnings outlook of large tech firms and how the bond market prices credit risk tied to AI spending.

Yardeni Research founder and CEO Ed Yardeni also sees this as a focal point for investors. He said, "Concerns about future investment returns are pushing up borrowing costs," and "investors may be lowering growth expectations because they fear the AI hype is slowing."

However, he does not expect AI investment to cool. He said, "We are far from being able to declare the AI investment boom over." He believes large cloud providers have strong cash flows and solid balance sheets, "making their spending plans relatively insulated from higher borrowing costs," while smaller rivals face challenges.

He noted, "Compute demand continues to outstrip supply, and rising AI adoption should drive further investment. We expect large cloud providers to keep increasing spend, and the 'prosperous 2020s' will keep thriving."
In the coming weeks we will see more clearly the evolution of the latest market tug‑of‑war between bonds and large‑cap tech stocks. That battle promises to be quite a spectacle.

items.title: 華爾街老將示警：美股早已「內部崩盤」！看好Nike、白銀布局機會
items.title_en: Wall Street Veteran Warns: US Stocks Already 'Internally Collapsed'—Bullish on Nike and Silver Opportunities
paras: 投資人若擔心美股即將全面崩盤，不妨先看看市場內部的情況。華爾街資深人士Larry McDonald指出，許多股票早已大幅貶值，市場其實已經歷一場「崩盤」。
儘管標普500指數(S&P 500)近期再創歷史新高，身為《The Bear Traps Report》作者的McDonald仍表示，市場「內部已經崩盤」。他說：「看看那些名列殿堂級的品牌，哈雷(Harley-Davidson)(HOG-US)股價下跌30%至40%，Lennar(LEN-US)下跌45%，這些都是非常優秀的美國品牌」，如今卻遭到重挫。

指數創新高與個股下跌背離 被動投資制度遭質疑

McDonald將指數屢創新高、個股卻遭到拋售的背離現象，歸因於日益「失靈」的被動投資制度。
隨著退休基金及指數股票型基金(ETF)持續流入大型科技股，State Street SPDR標普500 ETF Trust(SPY-US)等指數基金表面上仍穩健，但市場內部的分化卻愈來愈嚴重。
他指出，機構投資人與避險基金，也就是所謂的「聰明錢」，一方面做多指數，另一方面則放空大量個股，押注這些股票下跌。
此外，季底與年底的稅損賣壓也加劇市場波動。這是因為，共同基金與個人投資人會賣出表現最差的股票，以降低資本利得稅負，已經承受壓力的股票因此進一步下跌，其他公司股票也可能僅因投資人採取稅損策略而遭到賣出。

CoreWeave可轉債融資警訊 重演1999與2021年情境？

曾任雷曼兄弟(Lehman Brothers)不良債務與可轉換證券副總裁的McDonald，也對可轉換公司債市場感到憂心，尤其是新型雲端服務商(neocloud)。
可轉換公司債是可由發行人轉換為普通股的債券。以CoreWeave(CRWV-US)為例，該公司本周稍早引發股市投資人不安，其高收益債券因市場擔憂借款速度，以及AI投資最終能否獲得回報而大幅下跌。
McDonald表示，CoreWeave是「反覆發行可轉換債券的公司」，過去曾多次透過這類市場籌資的公司，包括Tyco與恩隆(Enron)。
他認為，這是「真正的警訊，因為這已經是最後一家酒館」，意指企業可能已接近其他融資管道難以為繼的階段。
他說：「上兩次出現這種情況是在1999年與2021年，這兩次都極具預示性，顯示重大事件即將到來。」2000年隨後發生網路泡沫崩盤，2022年則是股市表現不佳的一年，科技股尤其受到衝擊，部分原因是美國利率上升。

預期Fed降息三次 看好白銀與黃金

針對聯準會(Fed)利率動向，McDonald採取逆勢觀點，認為降息三次的可能性遠高於再升息三次。
他指出，面向消費者的企業正承受「巨大壓力」，包括麥當勞(MCD-US)、家得寶(HD-US)、Netflix(NFLX-US)、Nike(NKE-US)與Lululemon(LULU-US)，這些公司的股價今年以來跌幅已達雙位數，而消費者也正面臨能源及其他成本上升的壓力。
McDonald預期，Fed可能再升息一次，之後官員才會「表明轉向較寬鬆政策路徑的意圖」。
基於這項判斷，他認為現在是布局黃金與白銀的適當時機，因為貨幣政策寬鬆可能帶動大宗商品進入多頭行情。
貴金屬通常會在利率下滑時上漲，利率上升時下跌，而黃金價格今年來累積下跌3%，白銀則下跌18%。
McDonald認為，白銀是未來12個月「看起來最具吸引力的交易之一」。他說：「我看好白銀，因為資料中心支出正在增加。全球太陽能產業的成長簡直瘋狂，美國與中國即將新增的太陽能裝置容量也非常可觀。這些因素都對白銀有利。」
他進一步指出，美國家庭目前的貴金屬持有比例偏低。

Nike股價較52周高點腰斬 自由現金流與股息成支撐

McDonald也看好遭重挫的消費股Nike，目前該股股價已從52周高點下跌約50%。
他表示，雖然許多投資組合經理人寧可在邁向2027年之際持有輝達(NVDA-US)，也不願買進正努力扭轉營運困境的Nike，但他看好Nike的自由現金流與股息，認為這些因素能提供一定程度的「下檔保護」。
FactSet調查的分析師預估，Nike未來12個月每股自由現金流將達1.36美元。以周四收盤價37.14美元計算，預估自由現金流殖利率為3.65%。
Nike目前年股息為每股1.64美元，股息殖利率達4.42%，高於預估自由現金流殖利率，也高於過去12個月自由現金流殖利率的3.82%。
McDonald表示，他正關注一項可能在更長期內有利於Nike的重大事件。他說：「到了2028年夏季奧運，如果Nike股價從現在起上漲100%、150%甚至200%，我也不會感到意外。」
paras_en: If investors worry about a full-blown collapse of the US market, they should first look at the internal conditions. Senior Wall Street figure Larry McDonald points out that many stocks have already depreciated significantly, and the market has in fact experienced a 'collapse'.

Despite the S&P 500 recently hitting a new historical high, McDonald, author of The Bear Traps Report, still says the market has 'internally collapsed'. He says, 'Look at those hall‑of‑fame brands: Harley‑Davidson (HOG-US) has fallen 30% to 40%, Lennar (LEN-US) has fallen 45%. These are excellent American brands, yet they have been hit hard.'
McDonald attributes the divergence between index highs and individual stock sell‑offs to the increasingly 'failing' passive investment system.

As retirement funds and ETFs continue to flow into large tech stocks, index funds such as State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY-US) appear solid on the surface, but internal market fragmentation is worsening.
He notes that institutional investors and hedge funds—what he calls 'smart money'—are long on indices while shorting large numbers of individual stocks, betting on their decline.

Seasonal tax‑loss selling at quarter‑end and year‑end also amplifies volatility. Mutual funds and individual investors sell the worst performers to reduce capital gains tax, further depressing those stocks and causing others to be sold merely because investors are employing tax‑loss strategies.
McDonald, former VP of Lehman Brothers’ distressed debt and convertible securities, is also concerned about the convertible bond market, especially new cloud service providers.

Convertible bonds can be turned into common stock by the issuer. Take CoreWeave (CRWV-US) as an example: the company earlier this week caused unease among investors as its high‑yield bonds fell sharply amid concerns about borrowing speed and whether AI investment will ultimately pay off.
McDonald says CoreWeave is a 'company that repeatedly issues convertible bonds', and that companies like Tyco and Enron have raised capital through similar markets.
He believes this is a 'real warning, because this is already the last bar', implying that companies may be approaching a stage where other financing channels become difficult to sustain.

He says the last two occurrences were in 1999 and 2021, both highly prescient, indicating a major event was imminent. The dot‑com bubble burst in 2000, and 2022 was a poor year for the market, especially tech stocks, partly due to rising US rates.
McDonald takes a contrarian view on Fed rate moves, believing the likelihood of three rate cuts far outweighs the chance of three hikes.

He points out that consumer‑facing companies are under 'huge pressure', including McDonald’s (MCD-US), Home Depot (HD-US), Netflix (NFLX-US), Nike (NKE-US) and Lululemon (LULU-US). These companies’ stocks have fallen double‑digits this year, and consumers are facing rising energy and other costs.
McDonald expects the Fed may raise rates once more, after which officials will 'signal an intention to shift toward a more accommodative policy path'.
Based on this assessment, he believes now is an appropriate time to position gold and silver, as monetary easing could drive commodities into a bullish trend.
Precious metals typically rise when rates fall and fall when rates rise; gold has fallen 3% this year, while silver has fallen 18%.

McDonald believes silver is 'one of the most attractive trades over the next 12 months'. He says, 'I am bullish on silver because data center spend is increasing. The global solar industry is growing crazily, and the US and China are set to add significant solar capacity. These factors all favor silver.'
He further notes that US households currently hold a low proportion of precious metals.
McDonald also sees upside in the heavily hit consumer stock Nike, whose price has fallen about 50% from its 52‑week high.

He says that while many portfolio managers prefer to hold Nvidia (NVDA-US) as they head toward 2027, they are reluctant to buy Nike, which is trying to turn around its operations. However, he is bullish on Nike’s free cash flow and dividends, believing these factors provide a certain level of downside protection.
FactSet analysts estimate Nike’s free cash flow per share over the next 12 months will reach $1.36. Using Thursday’s closing price of $37.14, the implied free‑cash‑flow yield is 3.65%.
Nike currently pays an annual dividend of $1.64 per share, yielding 4.42%, higher than the estimated free‑cash‑flow yield and higher than the past 12‑month free‑cash‑flow yield of 3.82%.

McDonald says he is watching a major event that could benefit Nike in the longer term. He says, 'By the 2028 Summer Olympics, if Nike’s stock rises 100%, 150% or even 200% from now, I would not be surprised.'

items.title_en: <New York Forex> US Dollar Records First Weekly Decline in Over a Month as Rate‑Hike Expectations Cool and AI Concerns Persist
paras: 美元周五(16日)走低，兌歐元與日元均創下逾1個月來首見單週貶值，反映市場對聯準會(Fed)升息的預期降溫，以及投資人對AI引發股市賣壓的疑慮持續存在。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.17%，報101.87，本週下跌約0.35%。
本週公布的消費者物價與生產者物價數據均高於預期，一度令市場感到不安。不過，聯準會官員的談話顯示，目前沒有急於進一步緊縮貨幣政策的必要，有助於穩定美國公債殖利率，也削弱了美元的支撐力道。
AI類股本週大幅下跌，壓力也蔓延至部分信用市場。由於投資人已大量押注AI供應鏈各個環節，如今開始擔心資料中心營運商可能無法及時實現獲利，進而償還債務。
StoneX全球市場研究主管Matt Weller表示，「我認為今天乃至本週最值得關注的現象，是美元與AI交易之間的緊密連動。通常科技股遭到拋售時，市場會預期美元因避險需求而走強。我們確實看到部分資金流向債券，但美元實際上卻在下跌。」
本週英鎊與瑞士法郎兌美元的升幅居前。瑞士法郎受到避險需求支撐，市場也預期，即使利率環境進一步走低，瑞士仍不太可能將政策利率降至目前零利率以下。
英鎊兌美元上漲0.31%，至1英鎊兌1.3314美元，本週累計上漲0.63%。
美元兌瑞士法郎則下跌0.25%，至0.8246瑞郎，本週累計下跌0.67%。瑞郎在過去兩個交易日累計升值逾1.4%。
芝商所（CME）FedWatch工具顯示，市場預估聯準會本月稍晚維持利率不變的機率為83%，高於一個月前的49%。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)週五出席在曼谷舉行的國際貨幣基金（IMF）與世界銀行年度會議時，並未透露未來利率決策的線索。他表示，自己不會「預先判斷」任何一次會議的決策。
紐約梅隆銀行宏觀經濟策略師John Velis表示，「我認為，目前聯準會決策委員會內部，尤其是理事們，尚未形成足夠共識支持10月升息。不過，12月是否升息仍是未解之題，從現在到那時還有許多事情可能發生。」
歐元區財政風險仍受關注
法國財政風險仍是市場關注的背景因素。10月初，法國債務風險溢價曾大幅攀升。
歐元兌美元上漲0.08%，至1歐元兌1.1227美元。歐元週四已上漲0.56%，創下兩個月來最大單日漲幅，全週上漲約0.23%。
投資人預期，美國總統川普將避免讓中東或烏克蘭局勢進一步升級，因為更大規模的衝突可能推升通膨，進而損害他在期中選舉前的政治支持度。
美元兌日元下跌0.08%，至158.11日元。日元終止連續四週貶值走勢，本週升值0.13%。此前，伊朗衝突支撐美元走強。
近期油價上漲推升美元，同時對歐元與日元等能源進口國貨幣造成壓力。
日本銀行（BOJ）總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)週五再次強調，潛在通膨率可能超越央行設定的2%目標，仍是需要留意的風險。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Friday (the 16th), with both the euro and the yen posting their first weekly depreciation in more than a month, reflecting a cooling of market expectations for further Fed rate hikes and lingering investor worries that AI is weighing on equity markets.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.17% to 101.87, down about 0.35% for the week.

Consumer price and producer price data released this week came in above expectations, briefly unsettling markets. However, comments from Fed officials indicated no urgent need for further monetary tightening, helping to stabilise US Treasury yields and weakening support for the dollar.

AI‑related stocks fell sharply this week, and the pressure spread to parts of the credit market. Investors, who have heavily bet on every link of the AI supply chain, are now worried that data‑center operators may not generate profits quickly enough to service their debt.

Matt Weller, head of global market research at StoneX, said, "I think the most noteworthy phenomenon today and this week is the tight link between the dollar and AI trading. Usually when tech stocks are sold off, the market expects the dollar to strengthen on safe‑haven demand. We did see some flows into bonds, but the dollar actually fell."

The pound and the Swiss franc posted the biggest gains against the dollar this week. The franc was supported by safe‑haven demand, and markets expect that even if rates fall further, Switzerland is unlikely to push its policy rate below the current zero‑percent level.
The pound rose 0.31% to $1.3314, up 0.63% for the week.
The dollar slipped 0.25% against the Swiss franc to 0.8246 CHF, down 0.67% for the week. The franc had appreciated more than 1.4% over the past two trading days.
CME’s FedWatch tool shows the market now assigns an 83% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged later this month, up from 49% a month ago.
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh attended the IMF and World Bank annual meetings in Bangkok on Friday and offered no clues about future rate decisions, saying he does not "pre‑judge" the outcome of any meeting.

John Velis, macro strategy strategist at BNY Mellon, said, "I think the Fed’s policy committee, especially the governors, have not yet reached sufficient consensus to support a rate hike in October. However, whether there will be a hike in December remains an open question, and many things could happen between now and then."
Euro‑area fiscal risks remain a focus.
Fiscal risk in France continues to be a background concern for markets, with French sovereign risk premiums spiking sharply in early October.
The euro rose 0.08% to $1.1227. It had gained 0.56% on Thursday, the biggest single‑day rise in two months, and is up about 0.23% for the week.

Investors expect that President Trump will try to avoid further escalation in the Middle East or Ukraine, as a larger conflict could push inflation higher and damage his political support ahead of the mid‑term elections.
The dollar fell 0.08% to ¥158.11, ending a four‑week streak of depreciation for the yen, which rose 0.13% this week. Previously, the Iran conflict had supported a stronger dollar.
Recent oil price gains have lifted the dollar while putting pressure on currencies of energy‑importing countries such as the euro and yen.
Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda reiterated on Friday that a potential inflation rate above the BOJ’s 2% target remains a risk to watch.

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯不同調 續貶7.3分失守32.3元關卡
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Weakens While Stocks Hold, Falling 0.73 ¢ to Slip Below the 32.3 TWD Mark
paras: 在美元指數維持強勢、外資持續撤出亞洲市場影響下，新台幣兌美元今 (16) 日走弱，終場收在32.338元，貶值7.3分，續創近期波段低點，顯示國際資金仍偏向美元資產，相較於昨天的91億美元爆巨量，台北外匯經紀公司與元太外匯經紀公司合計總成交量為 46.12億美元。
儘管匯市承壓，台股表現相對有撐，加權指數終場收在47,111點，上漲141點，漲幅約0.3%，呈現匯弱股強格局。市場買盤主要聚焦 AI 伺服器、高階 PCB 及半導體供應鏈族群，在電子權值股支撐下，大盤成功守住漲勢。
從籌碼面來看，統計今日三大法人合計賣超約729億元，其中外資賣超高達494億元，已連續第8個交易日站在賣方；投信則持續扮演護盤角色，買超約132億元，寫下連6買；自營商賣超約367億元。
市場人士指出，本波新台幣轉弱主要受到美元升值效應帶動，近期美國經濟數據維持韌性，加上市場重新評估聯準會後續政策路徑，推升美元買盤，亞洲主要貨幣同步承壓，新台幣也不例外。資料顯示，10月以來新台幣已由31字頭一路走貶至32.3元以上水準。
觀察資金流向，外資近期持續調節台股權值股與電子類股部位，成為匯市與股市的重要變數。不過投信買盤明顯進場承接，加上AI相關產業基本面未見轉弱，因此支撐台股維持高檔震盪格局。今天市場呈現「匯率偏空、股市偏多」，除外資匯出導致台幣走弱，加上AI、高效能運算(HPC)及先進封裝需求仍強，吸引國內資金與長線買盤進駐，使台股維持相對強勢。
paras_en: Under a strong US dollar index and continued foreign‑capital outflows from Asian markets, the New Taiwan dollar weakened against the US dollar today (Oct 16), closing at 32.338 TWD, down 0.73 ¢ and extending its recent low‑point swing, indicating that international funds remain biased toward dollar assets. In contrast to yesterday’s massive USD 91 billion turnover, Taipei’s foreign‑exchange brokers and Yuan‑Tai FX brokers together handled a total volume of USD 46.12 billion.

Despite pressure on the currency market, Taiwan’s equity market showed relative resilience, with the weighted index closing at 47,111 points, up 141 points or about 0.3%, reflecting a “weak currency, strong stocks” pattern. Buying interest centered on AI servers, high‑end PCBs and semiconductor supply‑chain groups, and the rally in heavyweight electronics stocks helped the market maintain its upward momentum.

From a flow perspective, the three major institutional investors sold a combined net NT$729 billion today, with foreign investors leading the sell‑side at NT$494 billion for the eighth consecutive trading day. Trust funds continued to play a stabilising role, net‑buying about NT$132 billion for the sixth straight session, while proprietary traders sold roughly NT$367 billion.

Market observers said the recent weakening of the Taiwan dollar is mainly driven by the dollar’s appreciation. Recent US economic data remain resilient and the market’s reassessment of the Fed’s policy path has boosted dollar demand, putting pressure on major Asian currencies, including the TWD. Data show that since October the Taiwan dollar has slid from the low‑31s to above the 32.3 TWD level.

Looking at capital flows, foreign investors have been adjusting their positions in Taiwan’s heavyweight and electronics stocks, becoming a key variable for both the FX and equity markets. However, trust‑fund buying is evident, and the fundamentals of AI‑related industries have not weakened, supporting the Taiwan stock market’s high‑level range‑bound pattern. Today’s market displayed a “bearish currency, bullish equity” stance: foreign outflows weakened the TWD, while strong demand for AI, high‑performance computing and advanced packaging kept domestic and long‑term buying interest in equities, allowing the stock market to stay relatively strong.

上個月零售銷售增幅高於預期，主要受到汽油價格上漲帶動，每週初領失業救濟金人數則小幅增加，顯示消費需求仍具韌性，勞動市場也維持穩定。
但美國公債價格上漲，美元則回落，反映聯準會(Fed)官員近期發表審慎言論，進一步降低市場對 10 月升息的預期。
Monex USA交易主管 Juan Perez 表示，「目前市場存在一種不利美元的論述，原因在於，通膨若維持在這樣的水準，且以如此快的速度上升，將難以持續。」
他表示，「無論戰事方面沒有好消息，或股市前景看起來悲觀，在過去四週美元大幅走強之後，市場仍傾向拋售美元……經濟停滯似乎對交易員的想法產生更大的影響。」

芝商所（CME Group）FedWatch 工具顯示，交易員目前預期，聯準會在 10 月 27 日至 28 日的會議上維持利率不變的機率為 73%，高於一個月前的 53%。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Thursday (the 15th) from an 18‑month high as investors shifted their focus from strong U.S. inflation and consumer spending data to the sell‑off in bonds of AI data‑center operators.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.45% to 101.99. Earlier, U.S. inflation data came in above expectations, pushing the index to an 18‑month peak on Wednesday.

U.S. September producer prices (PPI) rose at the fastest pace in four and a half years, with costs for goods and services climbing together, further showing inflation pressure spreading from the energy sector to other areas.

Last month’s retail sales growth exceeded expectations, driven mainly by higher gasoline prices, while initial unemployment claims rose slightly, indicating consumer demand remains resilient and the labor market stays stable.
However, U.S. Treasury prices rose and the dollar retreated, reflecting recent cautious remarks from Federal Reserve officials that further lowered market expectations of a rate hike in October.

Juan Perez, head of trading at Monex USA, said, "There is currently a narrative that is unfavorable to the dollar because if inflation stays at this level and rises this quickly, it will be hard to sustain."

He added, "Whether there is no good news on the war front or the equity outlook looks bleak, after the dollar’s strong run over the past four weeks the market still tends to sell the greenback… stagnation seems to have a bigger impact on traders’ thinking."
AI companies' debt burdens draw attention
The dollar’s decline lifted the euro, which rose 0.56% against the dollar from an 18‑month low to $1.1218, marking the biggest single‑day gain in nearly two months.
The pound rose 0.64% to $1.3275 after data showed the U.K. economy unexpectedly grew 0.1% in August.

Wednesday’s U.S. consumer price index (CPI) came in above expectations, initially boosting bets that the Fed would keep rates high for longer. At the same time, renewed worries about heavy debt loads at AI firms prompted a flow into safe‑haven assets such as U.S. Treasuries, intensifying market volatility.

Uto Shinohara, senior investment strategist at Mesirow Currency Management, said, "The sell‑off in chip stocks provided support for bonds, keeping yields at relatively controlled levels and offsetting the impact of inflation signals."
The CME Group FedWatch tool shows traders now assign a 73% probability that the Fed will leave rates unchanged at its Oct. 27‑28 meeting, up from 53% a month ago.

After the CPI report, the market’s probability of a rate hike surged, but Fed Vice‑Chair Michelle Bowman and San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly said the Fed could wait for clearer information before deciding, cooling the market’s rate‑hike bets.

LMAX Group market strategist Joel Kruger said, "If yields struggle to rise further and the dollar keeps getting sold each time it rebounds, it reinforces our view that inflation news has largely been priced in and the overall risk balance will favor risky assets."
Investors will also watch Friday for comments from Fed officials at the IMF and World Bank annual meetings in Bangkok, including Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, for clues on the central bank’s next move.
The Australian dollar fell 0.77% to $0.6919 after September job numbers in Australia unexpectedly dropped.
The yen appreciated 0.15% to 158.08 per dollar.

Shinohara noted, "The Fed is entering a pre‑meeting quiet period, and no major economic data will be released before the meeting, so market moves may still be influenced by geopolitical uncertainties related to Russia, Ukraine, Iran, and the development of the AI industry."

paras_en: Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market staged a double‑whammy of stocks and currency today (15th), as foreign investors pulled out en masse and the Taiwan stock index plunged over a thousand points. The New Taiwan dollar closed at 32.265 per US dollar, a depreciation of 1.92 ¢, with transaction volume ballooning to $9.115 billion, indicating a sharp rise in market hedging sentiment. Foreign and mainland Chinese investors posted a net sell‑off of more than NT$300 billion for the day, the main driver of the dollar’s steep fall.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.11 and weakened throughout the session, hitting a low of 32.452, a drop of 3.79 ¢ at its deepest point, and closed at 32.265, breaking a more‑than‑two‑month low. The Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange markets together recorded a record‑high daily turnover of $9.115 billion, shattering the previous single‑day volume record.

Currency‑bank officials said the dollar’s move was mainly driven by massive foreign‑exchange outflows from overseas investors, with the underlying cause being panic selling in the Taiwan stock market. The market fears a correction in global tech stocks and a decline in risk appetite, prompting foreign investors to adjust positions in both equities and FX simultaneously.

Looking at today’s stock performance, the weighted index closed at 46,969.87 points, down 1,655.96 points or 3.41%, with a turnover of about NT$1.43 trillion, reflecting a rapid weakening of market sentiment.

Institutional flows further highlight the magnitude of capital outflows. According to exchange statistics, the three major institutional groups sold a combined NT$370.076 billion today, with foreign and mainland Chinese investors net‑selling NT$302.555 billion and proprietary traders selling NT$95.824 billion, while only investment trusts bought a net NT$28.303 billion. More specifically, foreign and mainland Chinese investors sold NT$677.36 billion versus purchases of NT$374.805 billion, a net daily sell‑off of over NT$300 billion, becoming a key force behind the dollar’s sharp depreciation.

Market analysts note that the US dollar continues to attract safe‑haven flows, and US Treasury yields remain high, putting pressure on Asian currencies. Coupled with foreign investors trimming exposure to Taiwan’s heavy‑weight electronic stocks, the New Taiwan dollar has weakened more than regional peers. Today’s FX turnover surged past $9.1 billion, far above normal trading‑day levels, reflecting exporters, importers and foreign investors all adjusting positions together.

From a technical perspective, the New Taiwan dollar has been oscillating around the 32.00 mark. Today’s close at 32.265 suggests short‑term market demand remains dollar‑driven. If foreign outflows persist, further testing of the 32.30‑32.50 range cannot be ruled out.

The simultaneous large swings in stocks and FX today underscore that international capital flows have become a pivotal driver of Taiwan’s financial markets. Whether foreign investors can halt the outflow will be a key gauge for the dollar’s ability to hold the 32.00 level going forward.

items.title_en: UBS Maintains "Buy the Dip" Strategy for the Dollar
paras: 《Investing.com》報導，瑞銀(UBS)週三(14日)在給客戶的報告中表示，只要能源價格維持高檔，且AI投資題材持續發酵，逢美元回檔時買進仍是合適的策略。
策略師Shahab Jalinoos表示，G10貨幣市場本週走勢相對平淡，法國與德國10年期公債殖利率利差穩定在約140個基點。
他指出，從法國的角度來看，這個利差水準仍令人不安，也持續支持歐元兌美元應採取「逢高賣出」策略的觀點。
瑞銀預期，歐元將測試第四季的區間低點1.1050，並維持2026年底目標價1.1200不變。
Jalinoos指出，柴油價格可能接近穩定的初步跡象，為歐元提供部分支撐。然而，歐洲仍面臨風險，天然氣庫存處於異常低檔，天然氣期貨價格也升至本輪週期新高。
近期科技股走勢疲軟，可能促使美元進入部分整理階段，通膨數據也可能進一步降低市場對未來較長期間升息的預期。
他寫道，「儘管如此，我們的核心觀點仍未改變：只要能源價格維持高檔，且AI帶動的投資題材持續發酵，逢美元走低時買進仍是合適的策略。」
在商品貨幣方面，瑞銀認為，澳幣、紐幣與加幣目前處於整理階段，但由於市場對升息的定價有限，這三種貨幣都有機會收復9月的跌幅。其中，加幣是瑞銀最偏好的短線做多標的。
Jalinoos也反駁了「日本減持法國債券將推升日元」的看法。他表示，國際收支數據顯示，日本對法國債券的曝險部位已大幅下降。
paras_en: Investing.com reported that UBS on Wednesday (the 14th) said in a client report that as long as energy prices stay high and AI‑related investment themes keep developing, buying the dollar on dips remains an appropriate strategy.
Strategist Shahab Jalinoos noted that G10 currency markets were relatively flat this week, with the spread between French and German 10‑year government bond yields steady at about 140 basis points.
He pointed out that from a French perspective this spread level is still unsettling and continues to support the view that the euro versus the dollar should be sold on rallies.
UBS expects the euro to test the fourth‑quarter low of 1.1050 and keeps its year‑end‑2026 target unchanged at 1.1200.

Jalinoos said diesel prices may be showing early signs of stabilisation, offering some support to the euro. However, Europe still faces risks as natural‑gas inventories are at unusually low levels and gas futures have risen to a new high for this cycle.
Weakness in recent tech stocks could push the dollar into a partial correction, and inflation data may further reduce market expectations for prolonged rate hikes.

He wrote, "Nevertheless, our core view remains unchanged: as long as energy prices stay high and AI‑driven investment themes continue to develop, buying the dollar on its declines remains an appropriate strategy."

Regarding commodity currencies, UBS sees the Australian, New Zealand and Canadian dollars as currently in a consolidation phase, but with limited rate‑hike pricing in the market each has a chance to recover September losses. The Canadian dollar is UBS’s top short‑term long‑biased pick.

Jalinoos also rebutted the view that Japan’s reduction of French bond holdings would boost the yen, noting that balance‑of‑payments data show Japan’s exposure to French bonds has already fallen sharply.

週三德勤(Deloitte)調查英國企業首席財務官(CFO)預計一年後通貨膨脹率升至3.4%及認為信貸成本高昂的比例創兩年半新高，而且法國財政問題衝擊歐元兌英鎊至十六個月新低，推升英鎊兌美元至1.3275高點。隨著英國央行(BOE)首席經濟學家皮爾稱市場對BOE未來一年加息四次、每次25個基點的推測過於激進，在美國CPI數據後，重創英鎊兌美元至1.3132低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3230-50，支撐於1.3130-50。

paras: 美元周三(14日)觸及至18個月高點，美國通膨數據強於預期，一度重新點燃市場對聯準會(Fed)可能在本月稍晚升息的預期。不過，隨著投資人重新預期聯準會將保持耐心，美元隨後自高點回落。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.34%，報102.53，稍早在上午尾盤一度升至102.94。

State Street資深全球市場策略師Marvin Loh表示，「CPI數據仍在影響市場估值，而股市下跌又提供了另一個推升美元的理由。」
這份通膨報告蓋過了聯準會官員近期釋出的鴿派訊號，包括紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)的言論。他的評論曾在前一個交易日導致美元走弱。
聯準會負責監管事務的副主席鮑曼(Michelle Bowman)週四也釋出訊號，表示在再次升息之前，將採取觀望態度。
另一方面，聯準會週三公布的「褐皮書」顯示，美國勞動市場仍處於「低聘僱、低解僱」狀態，但部分地區的通膨壓力有所升高。
Mesirow Currency Management資深投資策略師Uto Shinohara表示，「聯準會的雙重使命與勞動市場疲弱的跡象之間，仍存在拉鋸。明天公布的零售銷售、初領失業救濟金人數及生產者物價指數(PPI)，應能讓我們更清楚掌握消費者狀況、勞動市場與物價壓力。」

美國央行上個月將政策利率調升0.25個百分點，使利率區間升至3.75%至4.00%。
Angeles Investments投資長Michael Rosen表示，投資人對美國是否願意採取行動抑制通膨，正逐漸失去信心。
Rosen表示，「我們看到……美元走強受到較高利率的支撐。除非聯準會大幅升息、促使經濟陷入衰退，或是我們修正貿易與移民政策，否則通膨不會下降。」

多國財政與金融主管目前齊聚曼谷，出席國際貨幣基金(IMF)與世界銀行(World Bank)的年度會議。
IMF財政事務主管Rodrigo Valdes表示，IMF已提高對各國政府控制不斷攀升債務的呼籲力度。IMF總裁Kristalina Georgieva則表示，美國需要進行財政調整，讓債務走上更可持續的道路。
法國公債是近期全球債券拋售潮中受衝擊最嚴重市場之一。投資人擔心，明年總統大選前的政治角力，可能阻礙法國降低高額財政赤字的努力。
歐洲央行(ECB)總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)在曼谷出席CNN活動時表示，法國應透過財政整頓解決債務問題。這番言論降低了市場對歐洲央行可能開始買進法國公債、以壓低殖利率的猜測。
由於油價上漲，加上市場持續擔憂法國的財政狀況，歐元進一步承壓。
